description: PWA infrastructure + app shell + UI primitives: Serwist service worker source, web manifest, brand icon PNGs, root layout with the theme anti-flash script, Tailwind v4 globals, theme/shell/tab-bar layout components, the single-choke-point Icon map, and the reusable UI primitives. After this FEAT the app has a buildable shell with the four empty tab routes. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003. Grounded in design.md Sections 3, 12, 13, 16.
steps: Create src/app/sw.ts VERBATIM per design 12.2: import { defaultCache } from '@serwist/next/worker'; import type { PrecacheEntry, SerwistGlobalConfig } from 'serwist'; import { Serwist } from 'serwist'; declare the WorkerGlobalScope __SW_MANIFEST global and `declare const self: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope`; new Serwist({ precacheEntries: self.__SW_MANIFEST, skipWaiting:true, clientsClaim:true, navigationPreload:true, runtimeCaching: defaultCache, fallbacks:{ entries:[{ url:'/offline', matcher:({request})=>request.destination==='document' }] } }); then the single call serwist.addEventListeners(). Do NOT hand-wire install/activate listeners and do NOT optional-chain.

Create src/app/manifest.ts per design 12.3 (MetadataRoute.Manifest): name 'Heula', short_name 'Heula', Indonesian emoji-free description, start_url '/', display 'standalone', background_color + theme_color from brand token, icons referencing the four PNGs with correct sizes/type and purpose 'any' and 'maskable'.

Generate the four brand icon PNGs in public/icons: icon-192.png, icon-512.png, maskable-512.png (with safe padding), apple-touch-icon.png (180) — a plain brand-colored rounded square with a white 'H', NO emoji/decorative art. Use a small node generator script (e.g. scripts/gen-icons via sharp or a hand-rolled PNG encoder) or commit valid static PNGs; they must be valid PNGs so the manifest/install prompt works.

Create src/app/globals.css per design 13: @import 'tailwindcss'; @theme { brand accent, surfaces, radii, shadows }; @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); light/dark CSS variables; safe-area utilities mapped to env(safe-area-inset-*).

Create src/app/layout.tsx per design 13: html/body, viewport metadata with viewport-fit=cover + themeColor light/dark, appleWebApp + icons metadata (apple-touch-icon), and the EXACT anti-flash inline <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML> that reads localStorage 'heula-store', parses .state.theme, resolves 'system' via matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)'), toggles the 'dark' class, all wrapped in try/catch. Compose providers (ToastProvider, ThemeProvider) + AppShell + BottomTabBar.

Create src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx (max-w-[480px] mx-auto min-h-dvh + safe-area padding), ThemeProvider.tsx (reads store theme; subscribes to prefers-color-scheme for 'system'; toggles html 'dark' class; hydration-safe), BottomTabBar.tsx (fixed bottom-0 within the column, pb env safe-area-inset-bottom, four io5 tabs Home/History/Stats/Profile, motion active highlight, usePathname active state).

Create src/components/ui/Icon.tsx per design 16: the single react-icons/io5 import site; `const ICONS = { ... } satisfies Record<IconKey, IconType>` mapping every IconKey (imported from @/types) to its io5 component (outline/filled per the approved list); export an Icon component that renders by IconKey.

Create the UI primitives in src/components/ui per design 3: Card.tsx, Button.tsx (primary/secondary/ghost/destructive, large touch targets), Sheet.tsx (motion bottom sheet), Segmented.tsx (iOS segmented control), Stepper.tsx (onboarding dots), ConfirmDialog.tsx, Toast.tsx + ToastProvider.tsx (friendly copy, no emoji), EmptyState.tsx, Spinner.tsx. All copy from copy.ts.

Create minimal placeholder route pages so the shell builds: src/app/page.tsx (Home placeholder), src/app/history/page.tsx, src/app/stats/page.tsx, src/app/profile/page.tsx (these are fleshed out in FEAT-005/006).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` completes with zero TypeScript errors and no build-breaking lint, and emits public/sw.js.
The manifest route builds and references four valid PNG icons; `file public/icons/*.png` reports valid PNG image data for all four.
src/components/ui/Icon.tsx is the ONLY file importing from react-icons; its ICONS object satisfies Record<IconKey, IconType> (missing/extra key is a compile error).
layout.tsx contains the exact anti-flash inline script keyed on 'heula-store' -> state.theme wrapped in try/catch.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0 with public/sw.js produced.
Run `file public/icons/icon-192.png public/icons/icon-512.png public/icons/maskable-512.png public/icons/apple-touch-icon.png` and confirm all report PNG image data.
Run `grep -rn "react-icons/" src` and confirm only react-icons/io5 appears, and only in src/components/ui/Icon.tsx; run `grep -rn lucide src` and confirm no matches.
findings: Implemented PWA infra + app shell + UI primitives per design 3/12/13/16. src/app/sw.ts is verbatim per 12.2 (single serwist.addEventListeners(), no optional chaining). manifest.ts (MetadataRoute.Manifest) references the four PNGs with any/maskable purposes; brand token emerald #0e9f6e, background #f7f8f8. Four valid brand PNGs generated by scripts/gen-icons.mjs (zero external deps; built-in zlib PNG encoder) - plain emerald rounded square + white H, no emoji; maskable-512 uses 0.72 safe padding on a solid bg. globals.css is Tailwind v4 CSS-first (@import 'tailwindcss', @theme tokens, @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark,.dark *)), light/dark CSS vars, @utility safe-top/safe-bottom/safe-x). layout.tsx has viewport-fit=cover, light/dark themeColor, appleWebApp + apple-touch-icon metadata, and the EXACT anti-flash inline script keyed on heula-store -> state.theme in try/catch. ThemeProvider (store theme + prefers-color-scheme subscription, effect-only DOM mutation), AppShell (max-w-[480px] mx-auto min-h-dvh + tab-bar bottom padding), BottomTabBar (fixed, safe-bottom, four io5 tabs, motion layout highlight, usePathname active). Icon.tsx is the ONLY react-icons import site, ICONS satisfies Record<IconKey, IconType>. UI primitives: Card, Button (4 variants, min-h-12), Sheet, Segmented, Stepper, ConfirmDialog, Toast + ToastProvider, EmptyState, Spinner. Placeholder routes /, /history, /stats, /profile plus /offline (precache fallback). VERIFICATION: npm run build exits 0 and emits public/sw.js (41735 bytes); file public/icons/*.png reports valid PNG for all four; grep -rn 'react-icons/' src shows only react-icons/io5 in Icon.tsx (plus a doc-comment mention in the same file); grep -rn lucide src returns nothing. The two eslint warnings during build (_planLabel in notifications.ts, _exhaustive in recommendation.ts) are from FEAT-002/003 files, not this FEAT, and are non-breaking.
